_comment: INTERNAL/dev-only model switcher (D-016). Copy to dev-endpoints.json (gitignored), point DEV_LLM_REGISTRY_FILE at it, and run APP_ENV=dev. Keys are referenced by ENV-VAR NAME (api_key_env) and read from the process env — never inline a key here. `label` is the only user-visible string: keep it brand-safe (no engine/provider names). `native_reasoning` drives the chat Thinking pane (true = stream native reasoning; false = two-pass fallback).
